subtitle: Wyll: Bloodthirst is another matter. But perhaps not too big of one, if it's a devil or demon's flesh you're wanting to tear.

choices.text: How does the Blade of Frontiers end up chasing a devil in the Hells? i
Tell me, Wyll: How did you come to be the Blade of Frontiers?
I've noticed your stone eye. Did you lose it in battle?
[don't suppose you've come across an expert healer in your travels.
I've got no memory of my past. Could the parasite have done that?
Go to camp and wait for me there.
